title: Medicines this build can code
binding: a questionnaire question's `answer_value_set`, when the answer carries the concept
source: A STARTER SET, NOT A FORMULARY. Every medicine here is marked P, primary level of healthcare, in India's National List of Essential Medicines 2022, the report of the Standing National Committee on Medicines, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, read 2026-10-31 from https://icmr.gov.in/icmrobject/custom_data/1720338777_report_nlem_2022_f_website.pdf. The report marks every medicine with its level of healthcare, P for primary, S for secondary, T for tertiary, and only P medicines are seeded.. It is short because the report publishes the level of care only in its annexures of changes, so these are the primary level medicines that document could be read to confirm, not the whole of the primary level list. No dose limit, no indication and no interaction is stated here and none may be inferred from the list. NEEDS SIGN-OFF: a facility formulary approved by a named medical officer, which is also what the `rx.prescribe` capability's own qualifier has been waiting for.
